title: Camps — the area above the roster (pass 1 step 2: R3-10, R3-02, R5-04, R3-09)
subtitle: April Vacation Camp, real preview screens (fake data). The changes are drawn on top for this picture only; nothing is built yet. Amber = what changes. To show the “removed campers” note, Sofia Nguyen (paid $140 cash) was really withdrawn in the preview first, so every screen here (Today and After) has 18 campers and Payments recorded $3,795 still includes her $140. The rows already approved: the duplicate box goes first (R3-10); a “Possible duplicate” row leaves To collect until it's reviewed (R3-02: Ava Thompson's second sign-up, $315, so To collect 6 · $1,355 → 5 · $1,040; Campers and Coming don't change); Payments recorded says how much came from removed campers (R5-04); Find a camper gets the shared ✕ and a “No campers match” line (R3-09). One decision is in section 3.

sections.heading: 3 · The decision: where does “1 possible duplicate” go?

columns.label: A · on the To collect card (recommended)

items.caption: PC 1280. A. To collect's note becomes two small lines: the money and “1 possible duplicate not counted”. Pros: the line sits on the only card it is about; no shared part changes (cards already take two note lines, rulebook v1.115); with Hide private details on, To collect is hidden and the line goes with it — right, since Campers and Coming still count the row. Con: the card is a bit taller (all four cards grow with it); the line wraps on tablet and phone.

columns.label: B · a second gray line under the cards

items.caption: PC 1280. B. Under the count line, a second line: “To collect leaves out 1 possible duplicate until it's reviewed.” Pros: a whole sentence, easy to read; cards keep their height. Cons: the shared count cards must learn to take two lines under the row (a shared change: Dashboard core's, or with your OK); the line is far from the card it explains; the code must hide it with To collect under Hide private details.

PC 1280. C. Added to the end of the count line: “… · Late pick-up: 6 · To collect leaves out 1 possible duplicate”. Pro: no shared change. Cons: long; wraps on phones; mixes two topics (the day's extras and money) in one line; must drop the end under Hide private details.

sections.heading: 4 · Find a camper (R3-09) and the Showing line

items.caption: PC, “zz” typed. Chrome's own ✕; the duplicate box and an empty table with “No camper with that name.”

PC, “zz” typed. The shared ✕ with its “Clear search” tooltip (shown as if the mouse were on it). In the roster's place, one gray line: No campers match “zz”. · Clear search, drawn like the cards' “Showing … only · Show all” line. Search words win over a card's words when a card is also pressed. (The legend line under it stays as today.)

row.caption: Phone 390, “zz”. ✕ with a 44px tap area; no tooltip on touch.
Phone 390, Coming pressed. “Showing coming Mon, Apr 19 only · Show all” (today's shared line, unchanged) sits under the count line, before Find a camper.

footer:
How it was drawn: mock-x6-roster-top.js moves the real duplicate box, changes the real cards' number and note spans, adds the shared icon button and the shared Showing-line markup. Real numbers from the preview: To collect today 6 · $1,355 (Ethan $245, Grace $395, Leo $15, Mia $166, Noah $219, Ava's second sign-up $315); after 5 · $1,040. Removed: Sofia Nguyen $140 (withdrawn in the preview for this picture) and Owen Walsh $0.

Recommendation: A — the line sits on the only card it is about, disappears with To collect under Hide private details, and needs no shared change.
Your choice: A, B or C?
